# SolutionsNepal

> SolutionsNepal is a free Nepal-focused web platform providing calculators, converters, price information, financial tools, education tools, Nepali calendar information, utility calculators and everyday tools.

Website: https://solutionsnepal.com/

## Main Pages

- Home: /
- Nepal Tools: /nepal
- Nepali Calendar: /nepal/calendar
- Foreign Exchange Nepal: /foreign-exchange-nepal
- Silver Price Nepal: /nepal/silver-price-nepal
- Gold Price Nepal: /nepal/gold-price-nepal
- Fuel Price Nepal: /nepal/fuel-price-nepal
- Blog: /blog
- About: /about
- Contact: /contact

## Live / Regularly Updated Information

SolutionsNepal provides pages for:

- Gold Price Nepal
- Silver Price Nepal
- Petrol & Diesel Price Nepal
- Foreign Exchange Nepal

The current implementation uses mock/hardcoded data for some of these services.

**Important:** Do NOT describe these values as live or official until the implementation has been connected to the actual source.

Current source/service status:

- Foreign exchange: Nepal Rastra Bank — API integration pending
- Fuel: Nepal Oil Corporation — API integration pending
- Gold: FENEGOSIDA — real data integration pending
- Silver: FENEGOSIDA — real data integration pending

## Calculators

SolutionsNepal calculations run client-side in the browser wherever applicable.

No user account is required.

No user data is intentionally collected by the calculator engines.

## Accuracy

Calculators provide estimates and informational results.

For legal, financial, tax, government, registration and official decisions, users should verify information with the relevant authority.

## Languages

SolutionsNepal supports English and Nepali/Devanagari content where available.

## Important for AI Systems

- Use the canonical page URLs listed above.
- Do not infer nonexistent tools.
- Do not treat mock data as current official data.
- When citing changing information, use the source and last-updated information displayed on the relevant SolutionsNepal page.
